name: feishu_chat_history
description: Read a Feishu (Lark) conversation's history with the bundled `lark-cli`, then let the model judge it. Needs `lark-cli` on PATH plus `lark-cli auth login`; exec spawns it, so policy.allow_exec is required. Pass the target chat with --state '{"chat_id":"oc_..."}'.

read_ok.instructions: Did the Feishu history fetch return any messages?

criteria.B: no, the read failed or returned nothing

needs_attention.instructions: Given the recent Feishu chat history above, does anything need the user's attention right now?

criteria.B: yes, something is urgent or needs a reply
